title: MAGPIE: Agentic Multi-Reference Image Generation via Executable Scene Construction
abstract: arXiv:2611.32462v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multi-reference image generation requires a model to preserve the appearance of selected subjects while arranging them according to an instruction. Despite recent progress in reference-based generation and compositional control, reliably organizing selected subjects into the intended scene remains challenging. Although existing methods provide various forms of compositional guidance, the planned relationships are not always explicitly instantiated for inspection and refinement before image synthesis. To address this limitation, we introduce MAGPIE, which represents the intended composition as a simplified 3D scene defined by an executable Blender program. A coding agent links each scene instance to its reference, checks the geometry and rendered view against the instruction, and revises the program to correct discrepancies. translated_title: MAGPIE：通过可执行场景构建实现的智能体式多参考图像生成
translated_abstract: 多参考图像生成要求模型在根据指令对所选主体进行布局的同时，保留这些主体的外观。尽管基于参考的生成与组合控制方面近期取得了进展，但如何可靠地将所选主体组织到预期场景中仍然具有挑战性。虽然现有方法提供了各种形式的组合指导，但所规划的关系并不总能在图像合成之前被显式实例化以供检查和修正。为解决这一局限，我们提出了MAGPIE，它将预期的构图表示为由可执行的Blender程序定义的简化3D场景。一个编码智能体将每个场景实例与其参考图像相链接，根据指令检查几何结构和渲染视图，并修订程序以纠正偏差。最终的代理渲染结果作为图像生成器的视觉规划。利用MAGPIE-Instruct-3K数据集，我们训练了……
tldr: MAGPIE将多参考图像生成的构图意图表示为可执行的Blender 3D场景程序，并由编码智能体在图像合成前自动检查、链接参考并迭代修正场景，从而实现更可靠的多参考图像生成。
en_tdlr: MAGPIE represents the intended composition of multi-reference image generation as an executable Blender 3D scene, where a coding agent links scene instances to references and iteratively verifies and revises the program before using the proxy rendering as a visual plan for image synthesis.
